svg.title: Does “Please check” catch the wrong dates?
svg.desc: Risk against coverage: of the deadlines a condition would keep if it held back the flagged ones, the share that is wrong (a missed deadline has no flag, so it is kept). LLM + rules tool: no flag 1 of 159 (0.6 %; 94.6 % kept), no flag or “worth a second look” 1 of 168 (0.6 %; 100.0 % kept), every date 1 of 168 (0.6 %; 100.0 % kept); Ordnung: no flag 5 of 128 (3.9 %; 76.2 % kept), no flag or “worth a second look” 5 of 162 (3.1 %; 96.4 % kept), every date 5 of 168 (3.0 %; 100.0 % kept); LLM + rules text: no flag 12 of 157 (7.6 %; 93.5 % kept), no flag or “worth a second look” 14 of 164 (8.5 %; 97.6 % kept), every date 14 of 168 (8.3 %; 100.0 % kept); LLM only: no flag 17 of 123 (13.8 %; 73.2 % kept), no flag or “worth a second look” 32 of 165 (19.4 %; 98.2 % kept), every date 32 of 168 (19.0 %; 100.0 % kept).
svg.text: Does “Please check” catch the wrong dates?
Wrong among the deadlines kept, flagged ones held back first; a missed deadline has no flag, so it is kept ·
168 deadlines in 189 synthetic letters · 3 held-out splits, each as recorded once · claude-sonnet-5
